p1_findings.finding: Waiting only covers an already-running exact watcher tag and has no timeout or periodic state receipt.
A noncooperating launch can race after the second query, and exact one-A800 UUID/model/driver/index0 is recorded but not enforced.
Major entrypoints, overlays and third-party roots are checked, but repo-root import shadows and DSEC sample-content identity remain incomplete.
Failures before final publication may leave ambiguous attempt/result artifacts without FAILED_DO_NOT_CITE or partial quarantine.
Final semantics do not re-cross-check every factor receipt artifact hash and only type-check the propagated M513 identity.

The independent second verifier rechecks population, regular/no-symlink members, member hashes and outer seal, but does not explicitly reparse JSON semantics or exact completion text; integrity is inherited from the first verified seal.
The persisted END SHA is sampled before final staging, sealing and publication; there is no fourth true-end sample, although the reviewed source has no command after final rename.

The final two absence gates plus cooperative watcher lock close internal/cooperative races, but mv -T is not renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE), and both Python verifiers resolve the staging root. An active external actor could race destination creation or replace the staging root with a symlink. This is outside the accepted static non-adversarial filesystem model; an exclusive kernel rename and explicit root lstat would harden it.

sigkill_window_audit.before_staging_complete: canonical absent; only hidden partial staging may remain
sigkill_window_audit.during_first_seal_or_verification: canonical absent; only hidden staging may remain
sigkill_window_audit.between_first_and_second_verification: canonical absent; hidden fully sealed staging only
sigkill_window_audit.after_second_verification_before_mv: canonical absent; hidden fully verified staging only under accepted non-adversarial filesystem model
sigkill_window_audit.during_same_parent_mv: rename atomicity exposes either hidden staging or the complete canonical directory, never a partial canonical
sigkill_window_audit.after_mv: canonical is already complete and verified; script has no subsequent command or failure window

claim_boundary.authorization_scope: exact runner SHA only, after exact M513 completion and all runtime gates pass

decision.reason: The canonical package first appears through the script's unique final same-parent rename after two complete sealed-staging verification rounds. No command follows publication, so there is no postpublish fail-open window; SIGKILL yields either no canonical or an already complete canonical package.
launch_conditions: exact M513 package and pinned source/input/runtime gates must pass
canonical destination must remain absent under the cooperative workflow
launch is training/valid825 measurement only and is not hardware admission
